description: Build a production line to expand capacity.
conditions: The production target in analysis identifies insufficient capacity, delivery risk, or a need to expand.
Demand is expected to grow and cash is sufficient for construction.
When higher capacity utilization is repeatedly needed but little utilization headroom remains, consider another production line.
When recovery_guard.summary.should_recover_any = true and recovery demand persists while available_capacity remains insufficient, consider building a line.
production.json.self_state.cash_guard.affordable_line_types includes the target line_type and blackboard.departments.finance.cash_summary does not report critical cash.
If no completed usable line exists, the first basic line may be built.
If a usable line already exists, production.json.self_state.margin_guard.summary.has_capacity_expansion_candidate must be true.
parameter_constraints: line_type must be small, medium, or large, providing capacity of 500, 1000, or 2000 respectively; choose according to demand.
constraints: Do not build a new line when cash_guard.guard_level = hard_blocked.
If no completed usable line exists, the first basic line may be built without a margin_guard expansion candidate.
If a usable line exists, inspect production.json.self_state.margin_guard first; do not expand without a candidate product that passes the gross-margin guardrail.
Base expansion primarily on persistent recovery demand in recovery_guard; do not add multiple backlog fields together and inflate the need for a line.
Validate cash availability and all action parameters strictly.
